performance_intent: Commit restores a small loop after reporting a 1.5–2.5% regression from the earlier SWAR helper in upstream per-commit benchmarks
checked_scope: All three changed fixed-lowercase literal comparisons, for char, char8_t, char16_t, char32_t, and wchar_t; additionally parse_infnan<double,char> with exactly eight arbitrary input bytes and general format
compiler: Clang 20.1.8, C++20, x86-64, -O2 for comparator and -O3 with forced inlining for parser

result.eight_byte_parser_old_to_new: 3/3 correct: value bits, consumed offset, error
result.eight_byte_parser_new_to_old: 3/3 correct: value bits, consumed offset, error
result.unrestricted_raw_helper: verified different for actual='a', expected='A', length=1: old true, new false

limitations: The raw generic helper differs for callers outside the library's fixed-lowercase-literal precondition. Direct parser proof covers eight-byte char/general input only; other lengths/types and public from_chars were not checked directly. No official historical before/after benchmark score was measured here.
